stories.title: North Wales PCC highlights victim support before prisoner releases begin
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin is reminding victims of crime that support is available ahead of the UK Government’s early release scheme starting on 1 October. stories.title: Mold Town Council office closed after doors and windows smashed
stories.summary: Mold Town Council’s offices have been damaged after glass in the entrance doors and surrounding windows was smashed, the council has confirmed. stories.title: Deeside’s Iceland Foods becomes first UK high street brand in the Falkland Islands
stories.summary: Deeside-based Iceland Foods will become the first UK high street retailer to open a store in the Falkland Islands. The new store, at K4, Ross Road East in the capital Stanley, will open in early December under a franchise partnership with local retailer Kelper Stores, part of the Fortuna group. stories.title: Second fly-tipping incident at protected site near Halkyn, NRW says
stories.summary: Used motor oil has been fly-tipped for a second time at Moel-y-Crio near Halkyn, Flintshire, Natural Resources Wales has said. NRW attended the site alongside North Wales Police’s Rural Crime Team after reports that several drums of oil had been dumped.
